title: Fills in every placeholder in the notification
goal: Use replaceAll to replace all identical tokens in a string.
summary: The batch notification will quote the venue name twice in the title and body. When a venue is inserted, all {room} placeholders should update.
tasks: completes fillRoom(template, room) and replaces every {room} in the text with room.
Keep other contents as they are, and text without placeholders is returned directly.

example.note: When a string is used as the matching condition, replace only replaces the first occurrence.

hint: replaceAll can find fixed strings. If the input may contain $, use callback () => room to insert it as is.
